sources.note: DTO generator help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: A Java record option generates an immutable record with automatic equals, hashCode and toString.
claims.supports: Java record: immutable record with automatic equals(), hashCode(), toString()

claims.statement: By default DTOs are immutable with final fields and no setters; Mutable is off by default.
claims.supports: Mutable off by default; default DTOs immutable with final fields and no setters

claims.statement: With Mutable on, fields are private and setters are generated.
claims.supports: When on, fields are private and setters are generated

claims.statement: An All args constructor option generates a constructor taking all DTO fields.
claims.supports: All args constructor: constructor taking all DTO fields

claims.statement: equals() and hashCode() and toString() options are generated from the DTO fields.
claims.supports: equals() and hashCode() generated from fields; toString()

undocumented: projection forms (interface/record/data class) via the projection action
